serving.limitations: Native vLLM used historical full-backbone exports, not the compact published HF packages. Peak allocated GPU memory is CUDA allocator peak, not total board usage.

architecture.frozen_strategy: Freeze all backbone parameters; train head only (3074 parameters)
architecture.lora_strategy: Freeze original backbone; train rank-8 LoRA adapters on q_proj/v_proj in all 28 layers plus classifier head; alpha 16; dropout 0.05

warnings: Historical constructed, previously examined benchmark, not an independent blind test
Comparisons across untuned generation, Jev hosted API, and trained classifiers use different inference protocols
Do not treat remote Jev latency as same-hardware comparison
Published HF compact packages use custom inference loaders and are not directly compatible with native vLLM
Precision/batching differs between quality and serving experiments
Do not invent other metrics, including Jev VRAM or p95 latency
